svg.title: Complete-case selection changes the diagnosis mix

cc:Work.dc:title: Complete-case selection changes the diagnosis mix
cc:Work.dc:description: Complete records were retained in 17.2% of CKD and 76.7% of non-CKD patients. Median creatinine changed by -0.20 mg/dL overall and +1.85 within CKD. The reweighted complete-case median was 2.20 mg/dL.
